name: Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party
notes: 25 party nights, 23 of them inside the window (from 12 Nov). Magic Kingdom closes to day guests at 18:00 on every party night (park.fan feed); party ticket holders may enter from 16:00. Adult tickets $189-$229 by date, children 3-9 $10 less; no day ticket or park reservation needed. Party days are typically lighter during the day than non-party days, but the afternoon fills with party guests from 16:00; non-party days (Mon/Wed/Sat in Nov-Dec) absorb the displaced day crowd and close at 22:00-23:00. Feed gap: 9 of these nights have no TICKETED_EVENT row in the park.fan feed (24, 25, 27, 29 Nov; 13, 15, 17, 20, 22 Dec), although the 18:00 day close is there.

name: Holidays at Walt Disney World Resort
notes: Included with admission: Main Street decorations, Frozen Holiday Surprise castle show, Jingle Cruise. The parade (Mickey's Once Upon a Christmastime) and holiday fireworks are party-only. 24-25 Dec hours 09:00-22:00 (feed). Christmas week (26-31 Dec) is the busiest stretch of the year at Magic Kingdom; Disney can stop selling same-day admission once capacity is reached.

name: New Year's Eve at Magic Kingdom
notes: Disney's event calendar confirms New Year's Eve celebrations and fireworks on 31 Dec 2026; hours 09:00-24:00 come from the park.fan feed (30 Dec also runs to midnight). Historically the most likely day of the year for Magic Kingdom to reach capacity; plan another park or arrive at opening.

name: Disney After Hours at Magic Kingdom Park
notes: Limited-capacity 3-hour event after park close; event ticket admits from 19:00. $189-$209 by date. Runs after regular close, so day guests keep normal hours (feed shows 22:00 close on 11 Jan). Feed: 11 Jan matches (22:00-01:00); 18 Jan has no event row (dropped by the early-entry collision).

name: Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party

Monday evenings EPCOT runs Extended Evening Hours 21:00-23:00 for Deluxe resort guests only (feed labels these TICKETED_EVENT; they are not a party).

name: Candlelight Processional
notes: Nightly at America Gardens Theatre, shows 16:45, 18:30 and 20:00 (closesAt is approximate end of the last show). Included with admission; standby lines form hours ahead, dining packages guarantee seats. Celebrity narrator schedule: Jordan Fisher 27-28 Nov ... Eva Longoria 28-30 Dec (see page). Popular narrators draw local crowds on those evenings.

name: New Year's Eve at EPCOT
notes: Disney's event calendar confirms New Year's Eve celebrations on 31 Dec 2026; the 01:00 close comes from the park.fan feed. World Showcase is packed from late afternoon; capacity closures possible.

name: Walt Disney World Marathon Weekend
notes: runDisney race weekend (sold out; 30th anniversary of the WDW Half Marathon). Races start pre-dawn and run through the parks and resort roads; expect road closures and early-morning bus disruption, full resort hotels, and a slight bump in crowds right after the holiday season. The race entry is the separate ticket; parks need normal admission.
